title: neonauclea glabra
intro: Neonauclea glabra, commonly known as Rau, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. It is a shrub or small tree with several medicinal properties, used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. Neonauclea glabra has been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
